instrument_audit.finding: The v1 instrument (legacy eta_route_probe_rows + render_eta_route_documents) carries the plan only as the corpus generator's hash-fingerprint context sentence (_context_sentence: 8 thematic words sampled by a hash of the ordering) -- the same defect class the Gate-1 step-0 probe convicted in observation protocol v2. On heldout routes the active subgoal is therefore mostly not a function of the readable input.

legacy_heldout_information_ceiling.note: A Bayes-optimal non-fingerprint predictor fit on train scores 0.1805 on heldout -- below the 0.25 bar; the v1 gate was unpassable by construction. Observed arms (base 0.166/0.214, pretrained 0.131/0.202) sit at this ceiling.

instrument_audit.v1_sealed_verdict: artifacts/eta_stage2_probe_20260803 gate-2-fail-kill-llm-transfer remains sealed as the v1-instrument reading; it convicts the instrument, not the substrate claim. This v2 preregistration re-tests the substrate claim with a readable-plan instrument and does not overwrite the sealed artifact.

corpus.note: Documents render the rate-distortion v4 staged-plan surface (step lines + expert actions); no fingerprint context line. Train-split orderings only; heldout excluded at generation time.

pretrain.note: max_length raised from 256 to 512 so no v4 document (max 442 tokens) is truncated mid-episode.

probe.feature: final-prompt-position hidden state per layer (capture_prefix_diagnostics, prefix_pairs=None)
probe.input: cumulative trajectory prefix through step k: past step lines with expert actions, bare step-k observation last (paper appendix-B regime)
probe.target: active subgoal = next objective ahead on the route
probe.layer_selection: train-split: fixed layer chosen by validation accuracy on a deterministic case-id fit/val split of the train rows only (sha256(case_id)[0] % 5 == 0 -> val); heldout never informs the choice; ties break to the lower layer
probe.truncation: fail-loud: any probe text over max_length raises instead of truncating

gate2_thresholds.condition_beats_base: pretrained selected-layer accuracy > original-Qwen selected-layer accuracy (causal contrast)
gate2_thresholds.decision: all three must hold to pass

decision_rules: Gate 2 passes only if all three conditions hold; then Stage 3 reruns the rate-distortion criterion on the merged base.

Gate 2 fails otherwise: with the readable-plan instrument (heldout ceiling 1.0 verified above), a fail now does convict the substrate claim at this scale, and the LLM-transfer route is killed; no Stage-3 rerun is run.
The continued-pretrained base is an offline rare-heavy substrate refresh (merged, frozen, fingerprinted); the original Qwen path is untouched.
The pretraining corpus contains only train-split orderings; heldout orderings are excluded at generation time, so the base never sees a Stage-3 evaluation trajectory.
The sealed v1 artifact (artifacts/eta_stage2_probe_20260803) is not modified or reinterpreted by this run beyond the instrument-audit scoping already recorded.
prohibited_after_execution: changing any of the three Gate-2 conditions or the 2x-chance multiplier
switching the layer-selection rule after seeing heldout accuracies
selecting the probe layer against heldout for the purpose of passing
using the ridge/regression probe R^2 in place of the classification accuracy gate
reusing the pretraining corpus routes as probe/Stage-3 evaluation routes
re-running with a different corpus seed or protocol and reporting only the better outcome

packages/vz-runtime/src/volvence_zero/ag.role: instrument-v2 owner: v4 protocol rendering, eta_stage2_documents, eta_stage2_probe_rows

supersedes.reason: Instrument audit (2026-08-03) showed the v1 probe/corpus carried the plan only as an unreadable hash fingerprint, capping the heldout information ceiling at ~0.18 against the 0.25 bar. The v1 prereg and its sealed FAIL artifact remain the v1-instrument record; this v2 prereg registers the readable-plan instrument for a fair re-test of the same substrate claim.
